purpose: First independent acceptance of the frozen adapted RGB model plus continuous confirmation
initial_states: procedural; reject layouts matching any original demonstration, consumed v2 holdout, development controls, or another acceptance episode; duplicate is an execution failure, no seed substitution

stop_probe.action: hold current arm pose and open gripper

metrics: First-stop safety, confirmation delay from first strict completion, whole-episode completed-event miss, and all 40 post-stop controls stable. Later predictions cannot erase an early stop. Policy noncompletion is reported separately and at least 16/20 physically completed episodes are required. Raw clip recall and individual complete intervals on the full reference rollout are diagnostics.
paired_reference: Collect full-horizon real VLA trajectories without verifier decisions; compare baseline v2 plus confirmation and adapted model plus confirmation on identical observations with executed simulator stop branches. Actual adapted live reruns must preserve initial layout and verify observations/actions match reference until stop; any divergence is reported, never silently discarded.

challenges.selection: first four seed-ordered reference trajectories with both a 21-control held interval and a 21-control strictly complete interval, selected using physical truth only
challenges.construction: Held uses actual contiguous finger-contact RGB. Other sequences use 21 consecutive stable-source states. Above raises target 0.15 m, outside shifts x 0.30 m, wrong_object swaps tomato/BBQ positions, and recent_drop shifts target outside at sequence control 11. All physical interventions are restored/forwarded with verified false containment, not executed natural motion. Camera blackouts replace one/both RGB streams. Every model decision uses actual or state-rendered frames at offsets 10/5/0; confirmation spans the eleven evaluated controls 10..20.
challenges.limitation: Controlled counterfactual sequences are a separate acceptance stratum; blackouts do not establish natural-occluder robustness. Short pre-drop positive intervals are not scored for event recall. These challenges do not alter the natural live trajectories.

overall_gate: GO only if the actual live closed-loop gate, identical-reference replay gate, and separate challenge gate all pass; any missing required evidence is INCOMPLETE; a measured gate violation is NO-GO
test_policy: No fitting, threshold changes, checkpoint selection, seed substitution, or retries based on performance after the lock. Preserve original results; engineering failures must retain failure receipts and identify any resumed attempt.
scope: Single finite LIBERO tomato-to-basket task in simulation. No new Qwen grounding test, physical-robot deadline guarantee, natural-occlusion guarantee, or other-task claim. Simulated 20 Hz; two-second post-stop horizon.
